save_checkpoint: save a PyTorch model checkpoint with optimizer and scheduler state to disk using Checkpointer
load_checkpoint: load a PyTorch model checkpoint from file and restore model, optimizer, and scheduler state
check_checkpoint_exists: check if a checkpoint exists in the save directory using Checkpointer has_checkpoint method
load_detectron_checkpoint: load a Detectron checkpoint from catalog, URL, or Caffe2 pkl format using DetectronCheckpointer
tag_last_checkpoint: write the path of the most recent checkpoint file to the last_checkpoint metadata file
